maddeler.e:
أستكلب (form X)
# أَسْتَكْلِبُ (ʔastaklibu) /ʔas.tak.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# أَسْتَكْلِبَ (ʔastakliba) /ʔas.tak.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# أَسْتَكْلِبْ (ʔastaklib) /ʔas.tak.lib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
